title: Volver a votar
goal: Read how, one after another between 1979 and 1990, Latin American countries returned to elected civilian government -- through collapse, negotiation, or Paraguay's own internal coup against Stroessner.

items: List several countries and the years they returned to civilian rule.
Contrast Argentina's rapid exit with Chile and Brazil's negotiated ones.
Explain how Stroessner's dictatorship ended in 1989.
Explain what new civilian governments inherited economically.
Use uno tras otro to describe a rapid succession of cases.
